emails.subject_line_a: Quick build for Atlantic Roofing & Construction
emails.body_text:
Hey Michael,

I was looking at atlanticroofingandconstruction.com — huge respect for 30+ years of family-owned roofing across Orlando.

One conversion leak caught my eye: your homepage has zero quote form at all, and visitors clicking Free Estimate get no instant Florida ballpark — especially after 6pm or on weekends when the office phones close.

So I built a working 30-second Orlando Roof Estimator in your signature coastal-blue Atlantic Roofing branding. Homeowners tap their roof specs and see an instant hurricane-code ballpark before leaving their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Most of our Orlando customers prefer calling (800) 411-0920 directly.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Phone callers will always be gold — and your 800 number stays front and center right inside the widget. This simply catches the 40%+ of homeowners browsing your site at 8pm or on Sundays when your office is closed, so they lock in an inspection instead of calling a competitor Monday.

objection_handlers.objection: Florida hurricane code and insurance jobs vary too much for online numbers.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — it never spits out a binding quote. It gives a realistic Orlando hurricane-code ballpark with an on-site inspection disclaimer, pre-educating homeowners on licensed pricing ($15k–$45k+) and tagging storm damage for priority follow-up.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already get steady business?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Because right now your homepage has zero quote form capturing after-hours traffic you're already earning. This installs in 5 minutes, routes full roof specs straight to your inbox/SMS 24/7, stays calibrated quarterly for Florida materials, and one single extra replacement covers 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone redesigning or messing with our website.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign required. It's a self-contained 28 KB vanilla JS script inside Shadow DOM isolation so it cannot break a single style on your site — and we'll even send your web person the 2-minute fix for that third-party toplocalroofpros.com schema logo URL for free.

objection_handlers.objection: Email me the pricing and I'll look it over with my office.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Happy to — I'll send a clean 3-bullet recap ($750 one-time Florida-code calibration & setup, $149/mo hosting, 24/7 SMS/email routing, and quarterly updates, cancel anytime) plus the live link so you can tap through it on your phone. Good to check back Thursday morning?
